description: Either NAND or NOR alone represents every truth function with at least one input, without constants or additional inputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.single_gate_constant_free_complete (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GateKind) (n : ℕ)
  (h : 0 < n) (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TruthFunction n) :
  ∃ A,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GateNoConstants A ∧
      ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation (Fin n)), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v A = f v
